body.name: Compact polyhedral Gaussian endpoint games \(\mathcal G_p\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal G_p=\{\mathsf G=(H,\Sigma,\ell,u):\mathsf G\text{ satisfies }\mathrm{ass:compact-polyhedral-domain},\mathrm{ass:nondegenerate-gaussian-shift},\mathrm{ass:nonempty-identified-interval},\mathrm{ass:nontrivial-sign-ambiguity}\}\), where \(\ell(h)=\max_{j\in J_-}\{a_j^-+(b_j^-)^{\top}h\}\) and \(u(h)=\min_{k\in J_+}\{a_k^++(b_k^+)^{\top}h\}\).
